record.binding_note: 5 GB per rolling 24 hours is 150 GB in 30 days, or 0.136 TiB, so the daily byte window bands the month at about 7.3 times below 1 TiB. Crossing it disables running shares and refuses new ones until the window falls back, which is a hard stop rather than a throttle. Two request-rate caps sit underneath and would bind first for a request-heavy workload.
record.limits_note: the allowance is a byte volume over a period, which none of the six kinds names; the number is in egress.free_allowance and binding names per-ip-shaping as the nearest kind
